To get a clearer picture, I’d like to ask a few questions:

1) When you say your blood sugars are "all over the place," about what range have your readings been in over the past few days (for example, before meals and a couple of hours after meals)?
2) Have there been any very low readings (like ones that made you feel shaky, sweaty, or lightheaded)?

If at any point your blood sugar is extremely high or low and you feel very unwell or unsafe, please contact your clinic right away or seek emergency care.
